chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from some of his companions, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Mihrān, from the one whom he mentioned, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who had intercourse with his sister. He said: “He is to be struck one blow with the sword.” I said: “Then if he survives?” He said: “He is imprisoned forever until he dies.”

key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man subject to the legal ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām for a man who has intercourse with his sister?
ai.summary: This hadith states a severe legal ruling concerning a man who commits intercourse with his sister. It presents the punishment as a sword-strike, and if he survives, perpetual imprisonment until death.
